bool lit = true; foreach (Building b in home.listerBuildings.allBuildingsColonist) if (b is Building_ResearchBench && home.glowGrid.GroundGlowAt(b.InteractionCell) < 0.5f) lit = false; st["lab_lit"] = lit;
